domain: national statistics portal (Japan) - assessed as a task source for the East Asia tick; no candidate task survived triage
prediction_question: None formed. The portal's products are aggregate statistical tables (census, labour force, vital statistics, prices - survey outputs aggregated by publisher design); every candidate task shape they could carry (monthly panel exceedance, e.g. monthly deaths/liquidations/arrivals by region x category) is already a covered bench family with live members: za-statsa-liquidations-exceedance (ready), who-flunet-activity-exceedance (published), abs-visitor-arrivals-direction (published). No event-grain register is published on e-Stat (survey microdata requires a separate official application, not the portal).
prediction_time: Not applicable at portal level; monthly/annual statistical tables would state release calendar dates, but no task was formed.
target_definition: Not applicable; no target formed. The drop is at the task level plus the access instrument, before any target was proposed.

sources.name: 政府統計の総合窓口 e-Stat (government statistics portal, Statistics Bureau / Statistics Center)
sources.api: documented API at https://www.e-stat.go.jp/api/api-info/api-guide - MEASURED 2026-10-28: guide page states 'API機能をご利用いただくには、政府統計の総合窓口(e-Stat)のユーザ登録が必要です' (API use requires user registration); API terms-of-use https://www.e-stat.go.jp/api/terms-of-use (HTTP 200) 第2条: '本機能は、利用登録をした利用者のみ利用することができます' and 第3条 issues an Application ID after registration. Anonymous access = web-table browsing/CSV via the web UI only, which is the same scraping-the-UI shape rejected in the kr-kosis-kma-access park.
sources.license: e-Stat site/API terms require adherence to the portal's utilisation guide; government statistics are generally free to reuse with source attribution (出典), but the API instrument itself is registration-gated for this pipeline's purposes
sources.access: measured 2026-10-28 from the coordinator: api-guide and api root pages HTTP 200; /api/terms-of-use HTTP 200 with the quoted clauses; guessed URLs /terms and /help/main/help-riyou returned 404 (recorded as wrong guesses, not absent terms)

license_evidence.quote: 第２条（利用登録） １．本機能は、利用登録をした利用者のみ利用することができます。
license_evidence.note: e-Stat API機能利用規約, read 2026-10-28: the documented programmatic path is available only to registered users; registration is a free personal signup. Not a licence refusal - a registration gate like KOSIS. Kept unclassified (dropped before licence triage mattered); the standing policy treats undocumented anonymous programmatic paths as fragile UI scraping, per the kr-kosis-kma-access precedent.

measurements.probe_2026_10_28: Two anonymous fetches: api-guide page (HTTP 200, appId/user-registration requirement text captured) and api terms-of-use (HTTP 200, 第2条/第3条 quoted). Two guessed terms URLs returned 404 (bad guesses, recorded). No catalogue enumeration spent: the portal's product type (aggregate statistical tables) is its stated purpose, and no event-grain register exists on it; a task-level match with an uncovered family was not found, so the access question never became decisive.

rejection_reason: Dropped at triage, in the cheapest order: (1) TASK LEVEL - e-Stat publishes aggregate statistical tables; the task shapes it supports (monthly/annual panel exceedance by category x region) are already covered bench families with live members (za-statsa-liquidations-exceedance ready; who-flunet-activity-exceedance published; abs-visitor-arrivals-direction published), and the bench publishes nothing that mirrors an existing task, so a new family member needs an operator decision (air4thai/chilecompra precedents), not a discovery probe; (2) ACCESS - the documented API is gated behind a free personal user registration (quoted), identical in shape to the parked KOSIS record; the anonymous path is web-UI scraping, which the pipeline does not take. No source was probed beyond the terms/access pages.
review: Cheapest-uncertainty-first worked as intended: the source was closed before any schema reading or volume measurement was spent. This is a portal-level drop recorded so a future East Asia tick does not re-open e-Stat blind: (a) it is a task-source mismatch for the bench's uncovered families, and (b) its programmatic access has the same personal-registration shape as KOSIS. Reopen only if the operator names a monthly/annual panel family member for Japan and provisions an e-Stat user registration per the KOSIS precedent, or if e-Stat starts publishing an event-grain register with an anonymous documented API.
next_action: Terminal for discovery. Reopening condition stated in rejection_reason; no further probe planned.

jurisdiction.publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan / National Statistics Center (総務省統計局・統計センター) via e-Stat portal
